reference: Randomization: first time ARDS with PaO2/FiO2 < 150 on PEEP >= 5 cmH2O is documented within 48 h of ARDS onset in a ventilated ICU patient; cisatracurium infusion starts at this point in the treated arm.
draft: first time PaO2 / FiO2 < 150 with PEEP > 5 recorded during the patient's hospital stay

reference: First fluid-resuscitation bolus ordered for hypovolaemia during the ICU stay (randomization was within ~15 min of the decision to resuscitate).
draft: Day of randomisation (Day-0), when the patient is hospitalized in the ICU and needs fluid resuscitation according to the physician in charge.

reference: Time septic shock criteria are first all met (documented infection, >= 2 organ SOFA >= 3, vasopressor at threshold dose for >= 6 h), within 24 h of shock onset.
draft: first time septic shock is diagnosed and all inclusion criteria are met, including need for vasopressors and at least 2 organ dysfunctions as defined by a SOFA score >= 3 for at least 6 consecutive hours

reference: First fluid-resuscitation order in the study ICU during the current ICU admission (randomization occurred at the first resuscitation decision).
draft: First time fluid resuscitation is required and supported by at least one of the specified clinical signs during the ICU stay

reference: First time all inclusion criteria are met: suspected/documented infection with >= 2 SIRS signs, on mechanical ventilation, and on vasopressor/inotrope for >= 4 h; randomization within 24 h of that.
draft: First time the patient is treated with vasopressors or inotropes for ≥ 4 hours and is present at the time of randomisation, while meeting all other inclusion criteria.

reference: Intravascular iodinated contrast administration in an ICU patient; study hydration starts 1 h before contrast (3 mL/kg) and runs 6 h after (1 mL/kg/h).
First arterial blood gas meeting severe metabolic acidaemia (pH <= 7.20, PaCO2 <= 45 mmHg, HCO3 <= 20 mmol/L) within 48 h of ICU admission.
draft: First time lactatemia of 2 mmol/l or above coincides with pH of 7.20 or below, PaCO2 of 45 mmHg or below, and bicarbonatemia of 20 mmol/l or below during ICU admission

reference: First time a severity criterion (I8) is met in a patient hospitalised with community-acquired pneumonia.
First time all eligibility criteria are met (ICU, creatinine threshold, severe AKI criterion) with no urgent RRT indication.
draft: First time serum creatinine meets eligibility criteria (≥100 µmol/L for women and ≥130 µmol/L for men) and evidence of severe AKI is present (≥2-fold increase in serum creatinine from baseline, serum creatinine ≥354 µmol/L with ≥27 µmol/L increase, or urine output <6.0 mL/kg over the preceding 12 hours) during ICU admission
First documented need for emergency endotracheal intubation in an eligible adult patient.

reference: Diagnostic coronary angiography in AMI with cardiogenic shock, before revascularization.
draft: First time systolic blood pressure <90 mmHg for >30 min or catecholamines required to maintain systolic pressure >90 mmHg, combined with signs of impaired organ perfusion and arterial lactate >3 mmol/l

reference: First time an ICU patient with proven/suspected infection is on a continuous vasopressor infusion, within 24 h of ICU admission.
draft: First time vasopressors are initiated and the patient is admitted to the ICU with proven or suspected infection as the main diagnosis
